BEGIN
COMMIT
SELECT COUNT(*)::int as count FROM workflow_events WHERE application_id = $1 AND run_id = $2
INSERT INTO workflow_events (run_id, application_id, event_type, correlation_id, event_data, spec_version) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) RETURNING *
SELECT * FROM workflow_steps WHERE id = $1
SELECT * FROM workflow_events WHERE run_id = $1 AND application_id = $2 AND ($3::bigint IS NULL OR slot > $3) AND ($4::int IS NULL OR id > $4) ORDER BY COALESCE(slot::bigint, id::bigint) ASC LIMIT $5
SELECT status FROM workflow_deployment_versions WHERE application_id = $1 AND deployment_version = $2
SELECT secret FROM workflow_encryption_keys WHERE application_id = $1
SELECT * FROM workflow_runs WHERE id = $1 AND application_id = $2
SELECT * FROM workflow_steps WHERE run_id = $1 AND correlation_id = $2 AND application_id = $3 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, status FROM workflow_steps WHERE run_id = $1 AND correlation_id = $2 AND application_id = $3 FOR UPDATE
UPDATE workflow_steps SET status = 'completed', output = $3, completed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1 AND application_id = $2
SELECT * FROM workflow_events WHERE run_id = $1 AND application_id = $2 AND slot >= $3 AND slot < $4 ORDER BY slot ASC LIMIT $5

INSERT INTO workflow_queue_messages (idempotency_key, queue_name, run_id, deployment_version, application_id, payload, payload_bytes, payload_encoding, status) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, 'pending') RETURNING id
SELECT pg_notify('deferred_messages', '{}')
SELECT workflow_url, step_url, webhook_url FROM workflow_queue_handlers WHERE application_id = $1 AND deployment_version = $2 ORDER BY last_heartbeat DESC
UPDATE workflow_queue_messages SET status = 'delivered', delivered_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1 AND application_id = $2 AND status = 'pending' AND attempts = $3 RETURNING id

INSERT INTO workflow_steps (id, run_id, application_id, correlation_id, step_name, status, input, spec_version) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'pending', $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (run_id, correlation_id, step_name) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
SELECT id FROM workflow_events WHERE run_id = $1 AND application_id = $2 AND event_type = $3 AND correlation_id = $4 LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM workflow_queue_messages WHERE idempotency_key = $1
UPDATE workflow_steps SET status = 'running', attempt = $3, retry_after = NULL, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, NOW()), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1 AND application_id = $2
SELECT * FROM workflow_runs WHERE id = $1
SELECT status FROM workflow_runs WHERE id = $1 AND application_id = $2
UPDATE workflow_hooks SET status = 'disposed', disposed_at = NOW() WHERE run_id = $1 AND application_id = $2 AND status != 'disposed'
UPDATE workflow_runs SET status = 'completed', output = $3, completed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1 AND application_id = $2
UPDATE workflow_waits SET status = 'completed', completed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE run_id = $1 AND application_id = $2 AND status = 'waiting'
SELECT * FROM workflow_queue_messages WHERE status = 'failed' AND attempts >= 10 ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM workflow_queue_messages WHERE status = 'pending' AND NOT (id = ANY($1::bigint[])) ORDER BY created_at ASC FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT $2

SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MIN(next_time) - NOW())) AS secs FROM ( SELECT deliver_at AS next_time FROM workflow_queue_messages WHERE status = 'deferred' AND deliver_at > NOW() UNION ALL SELECT next_retry_at AS next_time FROM workflow_queue_messages WHERE status = 'failed' AND next_retry_at > NOW() AND attempts < 10 ) t
UPDATE workflow_queue_messages SET status = 'pending', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'deferred' AND deliver_at <= NOW()
UPDATE workflow_queue_messages SET status = 'pending', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'failed' AND next_retry_at <= NOW() AND attempts < 10

INSERT INTO workflow_steps (id, run_id, application_id, correlation_id, step_name, status, input, spec_version, started_at, attempt) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'running', $6, $7, NOW(), 1) ON CONFLICT (run_id, correlation_id, step_name) DO NOTHING RETURNING id

INSERT INTO workflow_runs (id, application_id, workflow_name, deployment_id, status, input, execution_context, spec_version, attributes) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'pending', $5, $6, $7, $8) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
SELECT COUNT(*)::int as count FROM workflow_runs WHERE application_id = $1 AND status IN ('pending', 'running')
SELECT id FROM workflow_events WHERE run_id = $1 AND application_id = $2 AND event_type = 'run_started' LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM workflow_runs WHERE id = $1 AND application_id = $2
UPDATE workflow_runs SET status = 'running', started_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1 AND application_id = $2
SELECT pg_try_advisory_lock($1) as leader
